postconditions.satisfied_by: Read global-crew.md + global-everyone.md; docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md present (no CREW_CONTEXT.md/GLOSSARY.md here); g4 handoff, TRIPWIRE_OUTCOMES.md, g3-result.md read. m1.title: Materialize the EDITED spine template and prove the placeholders resolved
m1.imperative: Run scripts/init_work_area.py against the EDITED skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json into a scratch work-id in this repo, then prove the materialized .agent-work/<scratch>/spine.json carries NO literal <commander-skill-dir>, <repo-root> or <work-id> token anywhere, and that the context c2 command carries a real resolved --root. A check whose materialized command still contains a literal placeholder never ran.

postconditions.statement: materialized spine.json contains zero unresolved <...> placeholder tokens and the context c2 command's --root is an absolute path

constraints: scratch work-id only; do not disturb .agent-work/issue-304/
do not point tooling at C:/Programs/f1Brainz

m2.title: Drive the MATERIALIZED spine through context end to end: degraded report, then honest discharge
m2.imperative: Drive the scratch spine through the engine's init and context steps, capturing the engine's own output verbatim with tee. Demonstrate (1) the context check REPORTS degraded rather than silently passing, (2) it is dischargeable WITHOUT --force or a waiver, and (3) context then advances to complete. Record the exit code at each stage, since stdout is discarded and the exit code is the only signal reaching the spine. If the only way past is --force or a waiver, STOP and report it as a finding.

preconditions.statement: materialized spine exists with resolved placeholders
preconditions.satisfied_by: materialized spine at .agent-work/g4-scratch-run/spine.json with placeholders resolved

postconditions.statement: scratch spine's context task is complete, its receipt records DEGRADED-NO-MAP with substitutes/unmapped/escalation, and no waiver/force appears in the spine journal

constraints: capture the engine's own stdout verbatim, never paraphrase

m3.title: Run the FULL suite and attribute any red by command
m3.imperative: Run the entire suite (python -m pytest -q, ~1160+ tests, several minutes; it has not hung) at the repo root and record the exact result line. If anything is red, attribute the distribution with a command such as uniq -c, never by reading the pytest tail. A local green is a local number, not the merge gate (local python is 3.14; CI pins 3.12).

postconditions.statement: full suite run to completion and its result line captured verbatim to evidence/g4-full-suite.txt

m4.imperative: Remove the scratch work area and VERIFY its absence (only claim a cleanup you have verified). Confirm .agent-work/issue-304/ artifacts and TRIPWIRES.md are untouched. Write IMPLEMENTER_RESULT to .agent-work/issue-304/crew-handoffs/g4-result.md with evidence pasted verbatim and every deviation named.
